archetypes.name: Abzan Outlast
archetypes.plan: Build around Abzan Charm: Develop creatures early, outlast when combat pauses, and turn the accumulated counters into shared keywords.

archetypes.name: Jeskai Prowess
archetypes.plan: Build around Jeskai Charm: Sequence creatures before cheap noncreature spells, trigger prowess in combat, and preserve mana for protection.

archetypes.name: Sultai Delve
archetypes.plan: Build around Sultai Charm: Fill the graveyard without losing board presence, then spend unused cards to cast delve threats ahead of schedule.

archetypes.name: Mardu Raid
archetypes.plan: Build around Mardu Charm: Attack early to turn on raid, replace attackers efficiently, and keep enough pressure that raid remains reliable.

archetypes.name: Temur Ferocious
archetypes.plan: Build around Temur Charm: Establish a four-power creature, unlock ferocious bonuses, and use tempo plays to keep the largest threat attacking.
